releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.33 - Elimination of Ad Creative Taps & Play Store Escapes
releaseNotes:
* Elimination of Ad Creative False Positives: Removed mid-screen circular glyph scanning ('Card Mid-Left' & 'Card Mid-Right') in video ads
* Hard Vertical Band Exclusion: Blocked all clicks in middle screen (normY in 180..820) during active ad countdowns and dismiss phases
* Purged Corrupted Patterns: Automatically purged 25 corrupt creative/ad-body patterns from Room DB
* Full Landscape Ad Support: Multi-quadrant corner perception across all 4 quadrants in landscape orientation
